skills.name: Fix something broken
skills.useWhen: an employee says something is broken, failing, slow or not working (VPN, email, Teams, laptop, printer, Wi-Fi, an application or website, an error message), asks how to fix it, or wants to report a problem or raise an incident
examples: My VPN won't connect from home
I get an error when I log in to SAP
skills.does: Checks known outages, gives self-help steps from the knowledge base and similar fixed incidents, asks whether they worked, and raises or links an incident when they did not.
skills.notFor: ordering new hardware, software or access: one item is the catalog, several items is 'Order several items at once'
skills.conversation: it asks what it needs, gives self-help steps, asks whether they fixed the problem, and raises or links an incident

skills.name: Order several items at once
skills.useWhen: an employee needs several catalog items at once or for several people: everything for new hires, a team move, a new office or project
examples: Laptops and Office for 3 new hires in Madrid next Monday
Everything my team needs for the move to building 4
Necesito portátil, móvil y acceso a SAP para un nuevo empleado
skills.does: Finds the items, asks the missing answers, adds them to the cart and submits the order once the employee confirms.
skills.notFor: a single item, which is the catalog, or something that is broken, which is 'Fix something broken'
skills.conversation: it asks the missing answers, confirms the plan and the cart, and submits the order only when the employee agrees
